description: This file defines heuristics and choices for kernel selection, fusion, and configuration in PyTorch's Torch Inductor backend, particularly related to choices of kernel templates, fusion logic, fallback heuristics, and autotuning strategies.

classes.name: Sortable
classes.description: Protocol for items that can be used as a sort key, such as int or tuple.

classes.name: FusionScore
classes.description: Data class representing the score of a fusion operation, with comparison logic prioritizing template score, memory score, and proximity.

methods.name: BaseConfigHeuristic get_config_heuristics( self, device_type: Optional[str] = "cuda" )
methods.description: Returns the heuristic configuration based on device type (cuda, cpu, xpu, mtia, etc).

methods.name: partial[Generator[TritonConfig,None,None]] get_conv_configs( self, device_type: Optional[str] = "cuda" )
methods.description: Retrieves convolution configuration heuristics for a given device type.

methods.name: list[Any] get_flex_attention_fwd_configs( self, head_dim: int, dtype: torch.dtype, device_type: Optional[str] = "cuda" )
methods.description: Gets configurations for flexible attention forward pass based on head dimension and dtype.

methods.name: list[Any] get_flex_attention_bwd_configs( self, head_dim: int, dtype: torch.dtype, device_type: Optional[str] = "cuda" )
methods.description: Gets configurations for flexible attention backward pass.

methods.name: list[Any] get_flex_decode_configs( self, head_dim: int, dtype: torch.dtype, device_type: Optional[str] = "cuda" )

Generator[KernelTemplateChoice,None,None] get_ktc( self, kernel_inputs: KernelInputs, template: Union[KernelTemplate, ExternKernelChoice], op_name: str, kwarg_overrides: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None, )
methods.description: Generates KernelTemplateChoice based on kernel inputs, template, operation, and overrides.

methods.name: list[ChoiceCaller] get_template_configs( self, kernel_inputs: KernelInputs, templates: list[Union[KernelTemplate, ExternKernelChoice]], op_name: str, kwarg_overrides: Optional[dict[str, dict[str, Any]]] = None, )
methods.description: Creates a list of ChoiceCaller objects for kernel templates, applying heuristics for layout and configuration.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] triton_kernel_kwargs( self, kernel_cls: type[TritonKernel], features: SIMDKernelFeatures, groups: list[sympy.Expr], kernel_kwargs: dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Hook to modify kernel kwargs for Triton kernels, e.g., to apply fixed configurations.

methods.name: bool should_use_cooperative_reduction(features: SIMDKernelFeatures)
methods.description: Decides heuristically if cooperative reduction should be used based on kernel features and global configs.

methods.name: bool should_use_persistent_reduction( features: SIMDKernelFeatures, cooperative_reduction: bool )
methods.description: Decides if persistent reduction should be used based on kernel features, reduction hints, and configs.

methods.name: int reduction_split_factor( device: torch.device, reduction_numel_hint: int, numel_hint: int, inner_reduction: bool, )
methods.description: Calculates heuristic split factor for reduction based on device, shape hints, and reduction parameters.

methods.name: bool can_fuse( scheduler: Scheduler, node1: BaseSchedulerNode, node2: BaseSchedulerNode, shared_data_score: int, )
methods.description: Heuristics to determine if two scheduler nodes can be fused, considering indexing, memory, and size constraints.

methods.name: bool can_fuse_vertical( scheduler: Scheduler, node1: BaseSchedulerNode, node2: BaseSchedulerNode, shared_data_score: int, )
bool can_fuse_horizontal( scheduler: Scheduler, node1: BaseSchedulerNode, node2: BaseSchedulerNode, shared_data_score: int, )
methods.description: Heuristics for horizontal (consumer/consumer) fusion constraints, including distance and memory checks.

methods.name: Sortable score_fusion( scheduler: Scheduler, node1: BaseSchedulerNode, node2: BaseSchedulerNode, )
methods.description: Assigns a fusion score based on type, memory savings, and proximity in the graph for scheduling purposes.

methods.name: list[KernelTemplateChoice] _finalize_template_configs( self, template_choices: dict[str, Generator[KernelTemplateChoice, None, None]], kernel_inputs: KernelInputs, templates: list[Union[KernelTemplate, ExternKernelChoice]], op_name: str, kwarg_overrides: Optional[dict[str, dict[str, Any]]] = None, )
